# Hanzo Works

> The business side of Hanzo: the browser extension, Hanzo Team, the bot on
> your team's chat, and 20 business apps — CRM, support desk, books, cap table,
> e-sign — on one login and one bill. Every product named here serves at the
> address beside it.

Hanzo Works is not a suite of separate products with separate logins. Each app
below runs on the same cloud, is scoped to your org by the same identity, and
meters against the same balance. An agent you grant an identity opens the same
apps your people do.

Identity is Hanzo IAM at `https://hanzo.id`. One login covers every product
here; this page holds none of it and signs nobody in, it links to the console.

## Install

- [Hanzo Extension](https://github.com/hanzoai/extension/releases/latest): Ask about the page you are on, search from the address bar, and let an agent read and act in the tab. Chrome, Firefox and Safari.
- [Hanzo Bot](https://hanzo.bot): An assistant that answers on the chat apps your team already uses — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Signal, Matrix and a dozen more. Runs on your own machine.
- [Hanzo Desktop](https://github.com/hanzoai/extension/releases/latest): Build agents and run models on your own hardware. macOS, Windows and Linux.

## Work

- [Hanzo Team](https://hanzo.team): Chat, projects, CRM, HR and hiring in one workspace, with agents on the team as members.
- [Hanzo Chat](https://hanzo.chat): Chat across models with agents, tools and your own documents in reach.
- [Hanzo Meet](https://meet.hanzo.ai): Video rooms for the org, with access decided by the same identity as everything else.
- [Hanzo Calendar](https://cal.hanzo.ai): Booking pages and scheduling.

## Build

- [Hanzo App](https://hanzo.app): Describe a web app and get one, deployed on a real address you control.
- [Hanzo Studio](https://studio.hanzo.ai): Author, test and publish agents against your own data.
- [Hanzo Base](https://base.hanzo.ai): A database, files and auth for what you build, per org.

## Customers

- [CRM](https://crm.hanzo.ai): The companies, the people, the deals in play.
- [Support](https://help.hanzo.ai): Customers file tickets, your team answers them.
- [Publish](https://social.hanzo.ai): Write once and post it on every channel you run.
- [Ads](https://ads.hanzo.ai): Paid campaigns, launched and paused from one place.
- [Marketing](https://marketing.hanzo.ai): Lifecycle email that reaches the right people.

## Money

- [Books](https://console.hanzo.ai/books): Double-entry accounting, bank reconciliation, and reports that balance.
- [Finance](https://finance.hanzo.ai): The wallet your org pays from — deposits in, usage out.
- [Pay](https://pay.hanzo.ai): Take payment, on your own checkout.
- [Commerce](https://commerce.hanzo.ai): Catalog, pricing, invoices and subscriptions.
- [Billing](https://billing.hanzo.ai): What you spent, on what, against one balance.

## The company

- [Cap table](https://captable.hanzo.ai): Stakeholders, share classes, grants, SAFEs and rounds.
- [eSign](https://esign.hanzo.ai): A document out for signature, signed and filed with an audit trail.
- [Data room](https://dataroom.hanzo.ai): A document room you share by link and watch page by page.
- [Analytics](https://analytics.hanzo.ai): Who came to your site and what they did.
- [Insights](https://insights.hanzo.ai): What your agents did, what it cost, and where it broke.

## Getting it done

- [Todo](https://todo.hanzo.ai): Boards and the work items on them.
- [Tasks](https://tasks.hanzo.ai): Long jobs that survive a crash, every run replayable.
- [Flow](https://flow.hanzo.ai): Draw an agent workflow on a canvas and run it.
- [Automations](https://auto.hanzo.ai): Work that runs itself, on a schedule or a webhook.
- [Search](https://search.hanzo.ai): One search across everything your org has.

## Works with

Connectors ship in `hanzoai/extension`: Google Workspace, Notion, HubSpot,
Zendesk, QuickBooks, Shopify, Figma, GitHub, GitLab, JetBrains, Jupyter,
Raycast, Sketch, Canvas, Salesforce, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Office,
DocuSign, Canva, Workday, Clio, iManage, Procore and Epic. Hanzo Bot answers on
WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Signal and Matrix.

## For agents

- [The API index](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1): The same work, reachable as routes. `GET /v1/<name>` lists that app's operations.
- [The OpenAPI document](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/openapi.json): The whole served surface, generated from the live router.
- [Hanzo Skills](https://hanzoskills.com/llms.txt): The full agent-facing index — every Hanzo standard, SDK and capability.
- [Agent onboarding manifest](https://hanzoskills.com/skill.md): How an agent authenticates with a human operator and works the cloud safely.
